scope: Projects and explicit exceptions for the root octane-tsc typecheck. Every published package's tsconfig.json and .tsrx-aware typecheck projects must be reached, or listed here with a reason and an expiry date.

publishedExceptions.reason: octane/compiler/volar virtual TSX passes a keyed @for row's `key` as a component prop (Clone.three.tsrx), types a <Suspense> without children as missing them (Example.three.tsrx), and passes an undefined ref to ThreeRef (Sky.three.tsrx); none of these errors has a source location.
octane/compiler/volar virtual TSX gives the @try boundary component in ErrorBoundary.ink.tsrx an `unknown` return type, so TypeScript rejects it as a JSX component; the error has no source location.
octane/compiler/volar virtual TSX types a forwarded ref in components.tsrx as `unknown`, which is not assignable to Ref<HTMLInputElement>; the error has no source location.

materializedProjects.reason: Compiles the upstream @floating-ui/react type tests that the React parity harness materializes into packages/floating-ui/tests/upstream/, which is gitignored, so a clean checkout has no inputs. The parity lane typechecks it after materializing.
